title: Where do the commas go in a long number?
description: A long eight digit number gets its commas in the Indian system and then in the American system, and is read out in each. Keeko then raises a hand, thinking the Indian system also puts commas in threes and reads twelve million.
teaching_notes: One idea: the Indian system cuts three digits first and then every two, while the American system cuts every three. Ask the class where the first comma goes before any other digit is grouped. Watch for students who use the American threes for an Indian number and read million.

source: Place commas in 12345678 in the Indian and the American system and read it in both
video_script.why: The child has met commas in lakhs and crores and the two ways of naming big numbers, and now places the commas in both systems.
video_script.substitution: Indian commas come after three digits and then after every two; American commas come after every three digits.
video_script.anchor: A long eight digit number with an empty row of comma boxes for each system, Indian and American.
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko groups the digits in threes for the Indian system as well, so the number is read as twelve million. Million belongs to the American system; the Indian system cuts three digits and then every two, and says crore and lakh.
video_script.payoff_line: In the Indian system the commas come after three digits, then after every two

final_answer.spoken: one crore twenty three lakh forty five thousand six hundred seventy eight in the Indian system, and twelve million three hundred forty five thousand six hundred seventy eight in the American system

never_show: the comma written numbers before the answer beat
maths_rules: Indian: last three digits 678, then groups of two: 45, 23, and 1 is left, so 1,23,45,678
American: groups of three from the right: 678, 345, 12, so 12,345,678
the slip: Indian commas in threes would give 12,345,678 and the name twelve million, which is the American form
video_script.design: One idea: the Indian system cuts three digits and then twos, the American system cuts threes. Wrong idea: Keeko uses threes in the Indian system and reads million. The anchor stays all video; the working band builds in the idea part; no hard clear.

<bookmark mark='m2'/>The number is written one comma twenty three comma forty five comma six seven eight.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>In the American system it is written twelve comma three four five comma six seven eight.
